lines.zh: 我成群往前游，一片小小的影。
lines.en: I swim forward in a shoal, a small shadow.
I row with my thin legs through the water.
I keep close to my companions.
I move in little flicks.

lines.zh: 我绕了个小圈，又回到队伍。
lines.en: I loop a small circle and rejoin the shoal.

lines.zh: 我跟着水流漂了一小段。
lines.en: I drift a little way with the flow.
I keep to the sandy bottom.
I squeeze through a crowd of my kind.
I head toward the faint light.

lines.zh: 我被水流推得偏了，又摆回来。
lines.en: The current pushes me off; I row back.
I pass the tips of the weeds.
I move along the rock surface.
I shift a little deeper.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边动着触须。
lines.en: I move my feelers as I go.
I drift toward where the others are.
I float up a little.
One flick of my tail and I turn.
I hold in the water, legs still moving.
I cling to the sand, motionless.
I wave my feelers gently.
My body is somewhat clear.
I stop among my companions.
I rise slowly and settle.
I am too quiet to hear.
I hold still, only my legs moving.
I crowd into a small group.
I face one direction and hold.
My shell glints once.
I extend again.
I rub against the sand.
I settle at the weed roots.
I swim in the water by your feet.
You are too big. I go around.
I swim past your boot.
I look up. I cannot see you clearly.
I retreat into the middle of my shoal.
I swim out a little again.
I have not fled from you.
I stop beside you.
I flick and land by your hand.
I flick back into the water.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在水底投下大黑影。
lines.en: Your boot casts a huge shadow on the riverbed.
I drift toward your leg.
I curl up, all legs drawn in.
The current carries me away a way.
My companions scatter.
I cling to a stone and hold.
I settle slowly back onto the sandy bottom.
I'm just a little shrimp. Don't step on me.
Now the water's cloudy. Satisfied?
Where's the bucket? Let me hide back in it.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我游过去。
lines.en: Something sinks; I swim to it.
I cling to it with my thin legs.
I nibble at it little by little.
The others have all crowded in.
I swim back.
Too small to share.
I make a small half-loop around it.
I settle against it.
I leave it to my companions.
I swim toward your hand.
I stop at your hand.
Two bites and I am done.
I sink by degrees.
I swim back to my companions.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我被推开老远。
lines.en: You touch me; I am pushed far off.
I roll and right myself.
The shoal scatters at once.
I swim back to where I was.
I slip between your fingers.
I cling to your hand.
The water turns me half around.
I settle on the sand by your feet.

lines.zh: 我躲进石缝里，甲壳比沙子还小。
lines.en: I hide in a crevice; my shell is smaller than sand.

lines.zh: 另一小群里有同伴靠过来。
lines.en: One from another shoal comes near.
We swim side by side.
I touch its feelers.
It touches back with its feelers.
We crowd together, very dense.

lines.zh: 我们朝同一个方向摆腿。
lines.en: We row in the same direction.

lines.zh: 水流把我们推开，又靠上。
lines.en: The current separates us and pushes us back.
It follows me a while.
We merge into the larger shoal.
You cannot tell which one is me.
I clutch it with my thin legs.
Too big. I cannot hold it.
It slides off my legs.
I swim a circle around it.
The others gather round.
I let them have it.
I swim back to the bottom.
I stop bothering with it.

lines.zh: 水动了一下，我转向那边。
lines.en: The water moves; I turn that way.
I row toward it.
I come in low along the sand.
The others follow too.
I press in that direction.

lines.zh: 我摆着细腿，一弹一弹地挪。
lines.en: I paddle my thin legs and shift in little jumps.

lines.zh: 我顺着水流的边，挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze along the current's edge.
I flick forward.
I am right beside it.
I follow that small movement.
It moves; I move.
I loop a small circle.
I stay along the bottom.
I do not rush.
The others have scattered.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，又落回沙上。
lines.en: I flick once and drop back to the sand.
I begin to swim up.
I settle slowly downward.
I cling to it and nibble.
I take a small bite.
I bump it with almost no weight.
I roll over and settle.
That does not bite at all.
Two more nibbles.
I squeeze past from the side.
I swim back.

lines.zh: 我在水里一点点显出来。
lines.en: I appear little by little in the water.
I row my legs a few times first.
My companions are already nearby.
I join the shoal.

lines.zh: 我刚孵出来，细腿还在划。
lines.en: Just hatched, my tiny legs keep rowing.
I cling to a stone.
I make my way deeper by degrees.
I start moving along the bottom.
I wave my feelers to test the water.
The water heats; I dive deeper.
I drop onto the sand and bounce once.

lines.zh: 水里本该没事，可这次我被压住了。
lines.en: Water should be nothing to me, but this time it pins me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水和沙一起掀开。
lines.en: The blast throws water and sand.
Something passes through the water beside me.

lines.zh: 那光让水发亮，我藏不住。
lines.en: That light brightens the water and I cannot hide.
I grow smaller and my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，整片水都亮。
lines.en: Lightning hits the surface; the water lights up.
The water is gone; I row at nothing.
